checks.detail: Independent ordinary input verified the five-action title, disabled no-save Continue, New Game cancel/confirm with both manual histories preserved, distinct history restoration, genuine loading and safe player control, return-to-title cleanup, real Exit/restart, valid Continue, depleted automatic continuation to Game Over, and early manual recovery. A richer bow history restored 20 XP, 11 arrows, equipment and committed rewards without adding lives. Shipped-camera coverage, an agent-authored view with the source camera unchanged, native 1280x720 images and fresh final runtime logs were collected. Fail: empty-slot Load hides its initial Back focus at 200%; the title mute preference leaves gameplay ambience audible. The 1920x1080/pointer and fault-recovery/audio matrix remains unverified. visual_camera_integrity=pass and environment_readability=pass for the inspected spawn/reachable entry views; adjacent_continuity=fail for the next HUD boundary only, nonblocking. Correction: native godot_project.get_info confirmed the exact candidate workspace and title main scene; the subsequent fresh runtime log was clean.

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: 优先交付正式游戏首页与进入游戏流程，按 operator-ui-story.md 和 PRD6.1/6.9：冷雾暖灯的河谷美术、清楚的游戏标题、统一装饰/衬线字体、精制按钮与图标、悬停/焦点/按下/禁用状态和轻量氛围动效。新游戏、继续、加载、设置、退出是真实操作；无有效存档时继续禁用并说明，加载有两槽真实预览，新游戏不静默删除手动档。进入显示必要真实加载反馈并抵达已有可玩场景，退出到标题不再只是文字提示；标题期间游戏AI不后台运行。保持现有人物、Forest、Snaiel战斗、剑弓任务与保存，不用枪械、调试日志/哈希/验收项装饰页面。Developer实际接入场景路由与保存接口；Tester普通输入验证功能、1920x1080/1280x720和中文缩放，与PRD界面参考图对比。缺设置入口的目标页面可以下一设置阶段完善，但首页不能长期继续当作占位。

developer_outcome.summary: Inherited architecture and focused runnable handoff passed. Independent game_title_entry_review remains pending, including the complete layout matrix, pointer states, distinct saved histories, zero-life recovery, failure paths, exit/restart and audio qualification.

risk_note.summary: The most likely insufficient-evidence outcome is a visually complete title whose transition does not prove selected-save restoration, safe spawn, absent background simulation or correct zero-life recovery. The local loader also has configuration dependencies and incomplete product error recovery.
risk_note.validation: Pair independent ordinary-input sequences with active-route/loading/readiness observations, authoritative save facts and world-processing observations; capture intermediate loading, returned-title and failed-save states as well as the final world. Require heard or captured UI audio separately.
risk_note.why_now: This increment changes the boot and recovery boundary around an already integrated game; incorrect ownership can silently reset progress or resume gameplay behind the menu.

task_requirements.requirement: Ordinary launch presents a finished Aelor title with five actions, coherent river-valley/old-lamp art, serif Chinese/Latin typography, restrained motion and sound, and distinguishable normal, hover, focus, pressed and disabled states; title, load and confirmation layouts remain readable and operable at both required resolutions and all three text scales, with no player-facing diagnostic content.

Ordinary input completes New Game, Continue, two-slot Load, functional Settings/back, return to title and software Exit with truthful loading/error feedback; manual histories survive New Game, selected histories restore their actual facts, zero-life continuation remains Game Over, title never simulates gameplay, and adjacent dialogue, equipment, combat, rewards and recovery retain their existing .
